allOf.description: A list of URIs representing departure places for this event. Each URI must reference a place in UiTdatabank. Only applicable when the event's `childrenOnly` flag is `true`. When not sent in a later update (or sent as `null`), the current departure places are kept; send an empty array to remove them. Setting `childrenOnly` to `false`, in an event body or with `PUT /events/{eventId}/children-only`, also removes all departure places.
